referee_caveats_inferred: The line is identified from a single frequency offset with no second CH3OH v=1 transition or rotation-diagram check, so a blend or unlisted species (feature D) cannot be excluded.
The abstract limit (r >~ 0.4 pc) differs from the main-text limit (r >~ 1 pc) with no reconciliation.
The CH3OH destruction radius is inferred from CND emission and is not modelled for a streamer on an eccentric orbit.
No uncertainties are given on the fitted frequencies, velocities or distances.
Observational parameters (bands, beams, sensitivity, calibration) are not given, so detection significance cannot be judged.
